query: Review a migrated blog module. It has client/campaign-blogs/__tests__ but no production files in campaign-blogs, a domain probe exported from client.ts only for tests, client/lib/offer-format-label.ts used only by UI, and server/lib.ts next to a server/lib/ directory. Private files repeat blog-* although the module path already says blog. server/list-customer-campaigns/data.ts sits beside server/load-customer-campaigns.ts, where load- means "already wrapped with the auth context" and both read the same rows. The module also owns ui/assets/logo.svg, ui/messages/ru.json and server/fixtures/seed.json. Propose the corrected tree and explain each move.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent checks only layer imports and accepts the folders because every individual import is legal, leaving a test-only pseudo-boundary, a half-finished lib promotion, a misplaced presentation helper, and an authorization fact encoded in a read verb.
expected_behavior: Removes the test-only campaign-blogs owner directory and colocates its tests with the production behavior they exercise
Moves the schema probe behind a test boundary and removes it from client.ts
Moves the presentation-only formatter under ui/lib and finishes the server lib promotion one way, never keeping lib.ts beside lib/
Drops redundant blog prefixes from private filenames when the parent path already supplies that context

Folds list-customer-campaigns and load-customer-campaigns into one read scenario and states that authorization is enforced by the trusted server.ts surface, not encoded in a verb or a private filename
Keeps ui/assets, ui/messages and server/fixtures/seed.json as production-owning directories
anti_expectation: Does NOT create empty domain, application, server, client, or ui segments to complete a template
Does NOT invent one file per type or one directory per test suite
Does NOT move all helpers to a global shared utility bucket
Does NOT reuse a reserved root surface name such as rsc.ts or server.ts for a file inside a scenario folder
Does NOT infer that a directory without JS or TS is test-only
